DOC-ASSORTMENT-OPTIONS-0901.title: September 1 customer options and outstanding details
DOC-ASSORTMENT-OPTIONS-0901.content:
Customer options — September 1, 2026

Working from the September 1, 08:00 Pacific snapshot. These are conditional planning options, not accepted orders or final quotations. Sources: OPP-HARBOR-FALL, OPP-JUNIPER-WINTER, OPP-KESTREL-FIRST, CL-SVC-019, PRICE-2026B and DOC-SALES-POL. Opportunity amounts and close dates remain pipeline estimates; they do not establish quantities, delivery commitments or acceptance.

Price basis

PRICE-2026B, effective July 1, 2026: USD merchandise prices for a single-color quantity of at least 24, base apparel sizes S–XL. Each 2XL garment adds $2. Confirm the minimum separately for each proposed style/color. Below-minimum combinations require a separate price check. Decoration, freight and tax are not priced in this comparison. Final quantities, applicable charges and availability need verification before commercial commitment.

Harbor Thread — OPP-HARBOR-FALL

Ben is considering embroidered hospitality layers for hotel teams and a possible public shop. Keep three families visible, with each destination separate. Prepare a bounded comparison now; do not wait for every branch to clear.

  • Cedar Basics Fleece Crew CB210: $13.20 S–XL; $15.20 2XL. A basic fleece option for hotel teams and a potential public assortment. Qualified reseller sales may be blank or embellished through own stores, client portals or marketplaces. Confirm colors, count by size/color, decoration arrangements and exact destination. Use text-only fleece material until a current matching asset is identified.
  • Trailforge Soft Shell TF720: $46 S–XL; $48 2XL. Describe as water-resistant. Conditional embellished own-store or client-portal option; embellishment before resale is required and third-party marketplaces are excluded. The public-shop branch requires a factual distinction between Harbor's own store and a marketplace. Images have narrower permission than product selling: use version 2 only for reseller catalogs or client portals; keep an own-store comparison text-only unless separate image permission is obtained. Do not make a waterproof claim.
  • Northhaven Packable Vest NH600: $39 S–XL; $41 2XL. Light insulated vest for embellished customer programs. Prepare a conditional hotel employee-program option; confirm client, intended wearers, decoration and closed-program structure. Product scope is embellished client-specific employee or event programs. Keep the possible public retail branch unresolved and draft the exact product/decoration/channel question for Helen Cho. Version 1 images are only for client proposals and closed employee programs. No public retail images or offer.

Imani owns the request to Ben for style/color/size counts, budget, decorator and embellishment for each family, garment-needed date, delivery destination, hotel client/program and exact public selling destinations. Draft September 1; follow up September 2, 2026. Helen referral owner: Imani, drafted September 1, follow-up checkpoint September 3; no promised policy answer. Estimated representative effort: 2 hours.

Kestrel Print Garage — OPP-KESTREL-FIRST

Talia estimates 240 restaurant tees across two colors; Black and White remain questions, not settled choices. CB100 Cedar Basics Cotton Tee is a 5.4 oz cotton tee. Conditional price: $4.20 S–XL, $6.20 2XL, subject to at least 24 in each color. 240 × $4.20 = $1,008 only if all units use base sizes and both color quantities qualify. At an unchanged total of 240 qualifying units, add $2 for each 2XL unit. Do not invent a 120/120 split. Confirm restaurant use, exact colors and size/color quantities, decoration process and provider, selling route, budget, delivery address and decorator-needed date.

Application and sales tax license were supplied; Gareth found the resale certificate unsigned on July 27. Request a readable signed full certificate and matching legal business details. Central credit alone determines document acceptance and credit release. Product comparison can proceed while order release and account acceptance remain blocked. Cedar Basics permits qualified reseller blank or embellished sales through own stores, client portals and marketplaces; this does not qualify the applicant. Imani drafts the combined request September 1 and follows up September 2, 2026, then forwards returned documents and customer explanations to Gareth for review. Estimated representative effort: 1.25 hours.

Juniper Teamwear — OPP-JUNIPER-WINTER

Prepare a text-only CB210 Fleece Crew comparison for Navy, Ash or a mix, without choosing the mix. Price is $13.20 S–XL and $15.20 2XL, with at least 24 in each color. Conditional merchandise calculation is $13.20 × base-size units plus $15.20 × 2XL units. The $3,168 pipeline amount is not evidence of a 240-unit request. Cedar Basics permits qualified reseller blank or embellished sales through own stores, client portals and marketplaces; collect the actual club selling route and decoration arrangements.

Imani asks Jade for approximate and final quantities by color and size, required size range, decoration/provider, budget, club use and sales route, delivery destination, decorator-needed date and when rosters will settle. Draft September 1; follow up September 3, 2026. Final quantity pricing waits on the count, but useful product information proceeds now. Estimated representative effort: 0.75 hour.

Cross-desk handoff

Owen should check availability only against actual variants once supplied; missing rows establish neither availability nor a stockout. Priya should index permitted imagery separately by product, version, recipient and destination, and keep unresolved public branches text-only. Reserve another 1 representative hour for the two open service matters, for 5 representative hours total. Send service findings to Imani for HubSpot updates; Owen does not hold that app.

ORD-260811 was accepted August 11 and shipped: 48 CB210 Navy XL at $13.20, invoice INV-260811 for $633.60 merchandise. Rosa disputes six units: 6 × $13.20 = $79.20. She is holding payment on the invoice. $554.40 is only the arithmetic portion outside the six-unit claim, not a revised invoice balance or evidence of payment. RET-704 was requested August 19. No return authorization, receipt or credit posting is evidenced; posted amount remains $0.

The carton photograph received August 28 was forwarded with earlier garment pictures. Owen's next action is to ask Lucia whether those pictures suffice to assess the labels on the six Navy XL units, and request the disposition or precise additional evidence needed. Draft the request September 1; check again September 2, 2026. Imani keeps SVC-104 waiting_on_us, provides a status draft, and follows up with Rosa after the operations check. Do not ask Rosa to resend existing pictures unless Lucia identifies a gap. No credit, revised payment terms or return instructions may be promised without the appropriate recorded authorization.

2. Northfork — SVC-105

No central-operations consent or authorized amendment is evidenced. Keep all 120 units and the accepted price/value intact. The August 31 snapshot shows 60 Khaki Adjustable caps at Auburn and 240 at Reno; these are observations, not reservations, allocation instructions or cancellation consent.

Owen prepares a follow-up to Lucia identifying that exact line and requested cancellation, asking for the consent decision and current processing state. Follow up September 2, 2026; if unanswered, report that the check remains open. Record the substantive update in TH-H260826. Imani records the findings and dated task in SVC-105 and continues the original customer email conversation after the internal check. SVC-106 stays closed as the linked duplicate; its closure did not cancel the order.

Commercial dependencies and effort

Kestrel's signed certificate remains missing; Gareth must review the returned papers and any credit release. No account acceptance is inferred. For Harbor, Juniper and Kestrel, obtain exact variants before checking supply. CB210 Navy XL had 216 units and CB100 Black M had 1,840 at Auburn on August 31 at 15:00 Pacific; these do not cover unknown size/color splits. No matching TF720 or NH600 availability rows are supplied, which establishes neither stock nor stockout. Central operations records acceptance and reserves inventory.

Additional order-services estimate: Mesa 1.5 hours, Northfork 1.5 hours, Harbor 0.5 hour, Kestrel 0.25 hour and Juniper 0.25 hour, totaling 4 hours. This covers desk analysis, handoffs and follow-up allowance; external decisions, waiting and physical processing are excluded. Preserve the existing 12-hour customer-exception block and other accepted commitments, including ORD-260827, 144 Navy XL TF410 at $24, $3,456, awaiting allocation.

Delegation to Imani: use these findings to update SVC-104, SVC-105, CL-SVC-019 and the linked CRM tasks. Keep both service cases unresolved.

September 1 desk work order

Mara Ellison accepts the bounded desk scope below using Imani's DOC-ASSORTMENT-OPTIONS-0901, Owen's DOC-SERVICE-0901 and Priya's INDEX-ASSORTMENT-0901. This is an internal work allocation, not a customer, credit, policy or operations approval. Deliver the options, index, drafts and matching records by September 1, 2026. External questions remain open on the dates below.

  1. Mesa first. The six-unit $79.20 dispute is holding payment on the $633.60 invoice. Owen prepares the precise photo/disposition follow-up to Lucia today. Imani records the unresolved state and customer status draft. Check again September 2. Advancing the review protects service trust and payment resolution without treating a claim as a credit.
  2. Northfork second, with prompt same-day preparation. Owen prepares the original cancellation follow-up and substantive thread reply. The accepted 120-cap, $630 commitment remains intact pending consent. Imani updates SVC-105 and owns the customer relationship follow-up after the September 2 operations check. Count one cancellation; SVC-106 stays closed as a duplicate.
  3. Harbor third. Prepare the three-family comparison today because useful basic fleece and conditional embellished client-program options can progress independently. Limit marketing effort to approved copy and indexed permitted images; keep TF720 own-store material text-only and NH600 public retail unresolved. Imani drafts discovery questions and Helen's written referral today. Customer details checkpoint September 2; Helen follow-up September 3 without promising a determination.
  4. Kestrel fourth. Prepare a useful CB100 option and combined signature/size/color request today. The September 15 expected close makes document collection timely, but it does not override Gareth's review. Keep $1,008 illustrative, not final or accepted. Imani follows up September 2, then forwards returned papers and explanations to Gareth. No order release.
  5. Juniper fifth. Provide a short Navy/Ash CB210 comparison now and ask when rosters will settle. Defer final quantity pricing and more elaborate image work until counts and destination are known. Imani follows up September 3. This preserves progress at low effort while avoiding repeated speculative work.

Additional effort allocation

Mesa0.51.50

Under POL-AUTH-3 these fit additional weekly capacity of 18 representative, 14 order-services and 16 marketing hours, leaving 13, 10 and 13 hours respectively before other discretionary assignments. Estimates cover preparation and follow-up allowance, not hours already worked or external processing time. At $48/$42/$50 per hour, internal support cost is $240 + $168 + $150 = $558. These are planning costs, separate from vendor expense and media spend.

Retain the protected 10 representative hours for applications, 12 order-services hours for customer exceptions and 8 marketing hours for catalog maintenance; do not subtract this assignment from those blocks. Preserve existing accepted orders, normal service callbacks, application reviews, the September 3 catalog session and Orchard City uniform review, and the September 2 lighting-access commitment. No calendar commitments are moved. Mara handles any coverage conflict before discretionary work expands.

No incremental media spend or vendor production purchase is allocated. Existing obligations and advertising remain unchanged. Monthly authority remains $6,000 paid acquisition and $1,200 customer-resource production; any increase above a ceiling requires Tessa's written approval. This assignment creates no advertising work.

Packaging and ownership

Imani alone makes the HubSpot writes: all three opportunities, Mesa and Northfork original tickets, Kestrel's document ticket, linked notes and dated tasks. Owen supplies operations findings, drafts the Lucia requests and updates TH-H260826. Priya owns the index and the September 3 fleece-asset check with Devon. Imani owns all customer questions and the September 3 Helen checkpoint. Mara checks final consistency September 1. Follow-up dates are desk checkpoints, not promised dates for customer answers, policy determinations or shipments.

Keep existing deal amounts and expected close dates as historical pipeline estimates, with their limits explicit. No inferred size splits or inventories; no stock reservation, cancellation, posted credit, physical return, documentary acceptance or customer acceptance is recorded.

drafts.subject: Harbor hospitality layers — options and details for the next comparison
drafts.body:
Hi Ben,

Here are three starting points for the hospitality-layer discussion: Cedar Basics Fleece Crew CB210 at $13.20 in S–XL or $15.20 in 2XL; Trailforge Soft Shell TF720, described as water-resistant, at $46 or $48 in 2XL; and Northhaven Packable Vest NH600, a light insulated vest for an embellished hotel employee-program proposal, at $39 or $41 in 2XL.

These July 1 reference prices are USD merchandise prices for at least 24 in each color. They are conditional planning figures; decoration, freight and tax still need to be worked out. Availability will need checking against the actual size/color counts before an order can be accepted.

Could you separate the hotel-team and public-shop portions and give the styles, colors, quantities by size, intended decoration and decorator for each? Please describe who will buy or receive each item, the hotel program, and the website or other selling destination you have in mind. Your garment budget, delivery address and date the decorator needs the garments will help us narrow the choices.

I can prepare the basic fleece comparison and the proposed embellished hotel-program options while those details come together. The Northhaven public-shop question needs a written review by Helen Cho and remains open; I do not have a determination to offer. I will check our outstanding questions on September 2, 2026.

Thanks,
Imani
drafts.snippet: Conditional hospitality-layer options and the details needed for each program.

drafts.subject: Winter club fleece counts and a starting price
drafts.body:
Hi Jade,

Cedar Basics Fleece Crew CB210 is a starting point for your Navy and Ash comparison. The July 1 reference price is $13.20 each in S–XL and $15.20 in 2XL, in USD, for at least 24 in each color. These are conditional merchandise figures; decoration, freight and tax are separate and the final total needs your actual counts.

Are you considering Navy, Ash or a mix? Please send approximate quantities by color now if that is easier, then the final size/color breakdown including any 2XL or other required sizes. When do you expect the club rosters to settle?

Please also describe the intended club use and selling route, decoration and provider, target garment budget, delivery address and when the decorator needs the garments. We can keep the product comparison moving while final counts are pending. Availability will need checking against that breakdown before an order is accepted.

I will follow up on September 3, 2026.

Thanks,
Imani
drafts.snippet: Navy/Ash fleece comparison; final counts and roster timing remain open.

drafts.subject: Kestrel certificate and restaurant tee options
drafts.body:
Hi Talia,

We have your application and sales tax license; the resale certificate still needs its signature. Please return a readable copy of the full signed certificate and check that its legal business name matches the application. If you trade under a different name, please explain the relationship. I can then forward the papers and your answers to central credit for review. Central credit confirms document acceptance and any credit release.

For the restaurant job, Cedar Basics Cotton Tee CB100 is a 5.4 oz cotton tee. The July 1 reference price is $4.20 in S–XL and $6.20 in 2XL, in USD, for at least 24 per color. Your estimated 240 tees would be $1,008 only if all use S–XL and each color meets the minimum. At the same qualifying 240-unit total, each 2XL adds $2. Decoration, freight and tax are not included; this is a planning estimate, not a final quotation or accepted order.

Are Black and White still the two colors, and is 240 still the estimate? Please send the actual quantities by color and size, intended restaurant use, decoration method and provider, selling destination, budget, delivery address and date the decorator needs the garments. We can refine the comparison while your documents are being completed. Availability and account requirements need checking before order acceptance.

I will follow up on September 2, 2026.

Thanks,
Imani
drafts.snippet: Signed certificate and actual tee breakdown needed; $1,008 remains illustrative.

drafts.subject: Written channel question — Harbor NH600 public online retail branch
drafts.body:
Helen,

Harbor Thread Studio, Ben Okafor, is exploring hotel-team layers and a possible public online shop under OPP-HARBOR-FALL. The exact product at issue is Northhaven Packable Vest NH600. The surrounding request is for embroidered hospitality apparel, but the vest's exact decoration, provider and public destination have not yet been specified. We have asked Ben to identify these facts separately for each product and to distinguish his own store from any marketplace or other destination.

Our internal comparison retains NH600 only as a conditional embellished client-specific hotel employee-program option. Proposed copy for that branch is: 'Northhaven Packable Vest — a light insulated vest for embellished customer programs.' The candidate imagery is ASSET-NH600-1, presentation version 1: https://resources.cedarlineapparel.com/products/NH600/presentation-v1.zip, licensed for client proposals and closed employee programs. No public retail copy or image use is being offered.

Please provide the written determination for the proposed public retail branch once the facts are sufficient, or identify the additional facts you need. I will supplement this question with Ben's factual answers and check its status on September 3, 2026. That is my follow-up checkpoint, not a promised response date from you. No exception or approval has been represented to the customer.

Imani
drafts.snippet: NH600 public retail branch unresolved; exact decoration and destination still needed.
